# certloom_channel (Resource)

A notification channel for alerts. The channel never stores a secret: `credential_ref` names where the certloom server reads one (for example `env:CERTLOOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`), so nothing secret reaches Terraform state. A channel named in the active policy cannot be renamed or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "certloom_channel" "oncall" {
  name           = "oncall"
  kind           = "webhook"
  config         = jsonencode({ url = "https://hooks.example.com/certloom" })
  credential_ref = "env:CERTLOOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET" # read by the server, never by Terraform
  min_severity   = "warning"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Non-secret settings as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode`. Webhook: `{url = "https://..."}`. Email: SMTP host, port, from and to addresses.
- `kind` (String) `webhook` or `email`. Changing it replaces the channel.
- `name` (String) Unique channel name, as the policy refers to it.

### Optional

- `credential_ref` (String) Reference to the secret on the server, such as `env:NAME` or `file:/path`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel receives notifications.
- `min_severity` (String) Lowest severity sent: `info`, `warning` or `critical`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by the certloom CLI or API.
terraform import certloom_channel.example <id>
```
